findings_summary: Independent adversarial review of the v1.13.3 release-preparation commit (version metadata + release documentation; the only product change in this release line is the already-merged hygiene performance fix from #345). The first pass reviewed commit 97c4198 and returned APPROVE_WITH_NITS with three documentation overclaims: docs/CLI.md and website/README.md asserted v1.13.3 assets were already published, and the changelog carried 'Status: RELEASED' while every other document called v1.13.3 a release candidate. The second pass reviewed the amended head 6a4c37c and verified all six applied corrections, replaying the release workflow's own status-token rewrite in node to prove the pipeline still matches the corrected candidate line. Across both passes it confirmed by inspection and by command that no product source file is touched (no crates/*/src, src-tauri/src or src), that the five canonical desktop version sources and the three Cargo.lock entries read 1.13.3 with the lockfile format version unchanged at 3 and `cargo metadata --locked` succeeding, that the deliberate CLI stream stays at 1.11.1 as the version checker's design requires, and that no corpus filename, prompt text, personal path or per-file hash leaked into the diff. Remaining items are one low and two informational nits, all pre-existing or explicitly optional.

findings.description: docs/CLI.md claimed the Linux desktop packages are published as 'v1.13.3 published', but no v1.13.3 tag existed. Reverted to the accurate latest-published version.
website/README.md listed the v1.13.3 Linux packages as already published under GitHub release assets.

The new changelog section carried 'Status: RELEASED' while the rest of the same commit framed v1.13.3 as a release candidate, contradicting the release workflow's documented pre-release convention. Now 'RELEASE CANDIDATE'; the workflow's status-token regex was replayed and still matches.

README asset table and install commands name v1.13.3 assets that are not yet published. Mitigated by the adjacent 'latest published' and 'current release candidate' labels and consistent with the established convention of the previous release-preparation commits; left as reviewed.

'byte-identical' and 'quellgleich zu v1.13.2' were looser than the measured evidence. Reworded to 'the normalized analysis output over a real archive is identical between v1.13.2 and this patch' and 'Produktquellcode gegenuber v1.13.2 nur im Hygiene-Performance-Fix geaendert'.
docs/INSTALL.md and docs/DEPLOYMENT.md version front matter was bumped without refreshing last_updated.
docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md still says 'Branch: main' while the checkout is release/v1.13.3. Pre-existing line, not modified by this commit.
The reviewed head is not yet an ancestor of origin/main, so the release workflow's ancestry gate would refuse a tag until this branch is merged. Expected ordering, not a defect.

review_chain.note: no product-code change, versions consistent, Cargo.lock minimal, no leakage; found documentation overclaims F1-F3 and nits F5/F6
all six corrections verified PASS; workflow status-token rewrite replayed; 16 metadata/doc files only; version consistency PASS; lockfile still three entries at format 3; no leakage
